victoryBackdrop.description: The Operation Cleared screen's image (Kev, 2026-10-17, DECISIONS_RESOLVED G-76): a res:// path to a 338 x 660 art px bleed canvas (docs/ART_SPEC.md). Absent or missing: the plain dark background.

victoryBackdropOffset.description: Per-screen vertical shift of the victoryBackdrop image (Kev, 2026-10-17, DECISIONS_RESOLVED G-85), in whole art px (4 design px), negative = up, so the image's focal subject sits above the report panel (taller on defeat). The painter clamps it to the bleed the screen leaves, so no edge is ever exposed. Absent: 0.

callsign.description: Short operation callsign shown in UI (e.g. FACILITY).

enemies.description: Fixed comp (anchors: battle 1, battle 10, one signature fight per op).

cloaked.description: This enemy spawns Cloaked (pkg2 cloak rules).

slots.description: Templated comp (pkg7.1): rolled once at run start from per-faction role pools so previews always show exact comps. Classification (derived from enemies.data.json at load): fodder = ai 'dumb'; bosses (standing-rule units) are excluded from all pools; heavy = remaining smart units with hp >= 90; support = remaining smart units with ally-aid fields (shieldAlly/shieldAllyAll/erb/erbAll/grantRampage/grantRampageAll) in >= 2 distinct kit zones; elite = the rest. 'heavyOrElites' resolves 50/50 at run start to one heavy or two elites. If a faction has no support unit (The Accretion), a support slot falls back to the elite pool.

oneOf.description: A fixed unit in a rolled lineup (G-98): this slot always fields the named unit; the other slots still roll.
